title: Resolve preserved-red findings — claims/transaction-line ACL exposures (F-C1..C3) and recovery-field semantics (F-A1/A2)
objective: Close the five preserved-red findings from the PR #303 enterprise validation without violating the standing operator decisions of 2026-10-25. Track C (F-C1..C3): adopt an explicit claims/transaction-line role matrix as ADR-129, then make the minimal ACL corrections — delete the two blanket `_all` CRUD rows (`access_claim_all` on plasticos.claim, `access_transaction_line_all` on plasticos.transaction.line), wire QC/operations managers into the claims groups via the established group-imply pattern, give the claim-photo auto-create a justified scoped sudo, and restrict the CSV transaction-import menu to managers — so TestClaimACL.test_claim_user_cannot_unlink, TestClaimACL.test_no_group_cannot_read and TestTransactionACL.test_base_user_cannot_write_tx_line pass for the right reason. Track A (F-A1/A2): encode the operator-decided manual recovery semantics (BUSINESS_SEMANTICS_UNRESOLVED — no auto-flow from resolved claims) by deleting the dead `_compute_chargebacks_penalties` code in both modules, correcting the misleading docstrings/help text, and rewriting the two claims-bridge tests to assert manual-entry semantics instead of the never-implemented auto-compute contract. No blanket sudo, no multi-addon ACL refactor, no computed conversion or backfill of recovery fields.
success_criteria: TestClaimACL.test_claim_user_cannot_unlink and test_no_group_cannot_read raise AccessError and pass on the Docker fixture — proof V1

TestTransactionACL.test_base_user_cannot_write_tx_line raises AccessError and passes; the previously-unexpected pass of test_base_user_cannot_unlink has an identified, ADR-documented mechanism — proof V2

test_freight_chargeback_recovery_flows_to_transaction and test_lightweight_penalty_recovery_flows_to_transaction are rewritten to the manual-semantics contract and pass; no `_compute_chargebacks_penalties` remains in the codebase — proof V1
Claim photo upload by a non-claims user still creates the claim (scoped sudo), and the full claims/transaction/commission module test rosters pass — proof V3
ruff check and format are clean and the full local gate passes — proof V4 and V5
